roots.origin: 拉丁语 conciliare（使结合、和好）← concilium（集会、联盟）
roots.core_concept: to bring into harmony / 使重新聚拢、和好
roots.core_image: 两个人闹僵后又坐回同一张桌前

roots.origin: 拉丁语 par（相等的、对等的），PIE *per-；parare（使就绪）同 PIE 但拉丁已分化
roots.core_concept: equal, on a level / 对等、相等
roots.core_image: 天平两端摆到同一高度，谁也不压谁

roots.origin: 拉丁语 compilare（堆在一起）← pila（柱、堆）
roots.core_concept: to heap together, gather up / 堆拢成册
roots.core_image: 把散落的纸稿按序叠成一摞
耳朵侧过去，听清那句话

roots.origin: 拉丁语 valere（强壮、有力、有效）
roots.core_concept: strong, in force / 强壮、有效力
roots.core_image: 一株幼苗在石缝里挺直腰杆顶开土块
roots.english_definition: to be strong, avail, be valid

roots.core_concept: a path, a way / 路、途径
roots.core_image: 一条大路笔直通向远处

roots.origin: 英语 hum（拟声词，低声哼/嗡响），与拉丁皆无关
roots.core_concept: a low humming sound / 低沉持续的嗡嗡声
roots.core_image: 机器低鸣，隔墙都能感到震颤

roots.origin: 拉丁语 humor（湿气、体液）——体液学说引申出生性与幽默
roots.core_concept: the body's moisture and temper / 体液引申出的性情与幽默
roots.core_image: 四杯体液各居其位，平衡了人就开朗

concepts.concept: to bring parties back together in harmony
equal and on a level, matched to another
to gather scattered pieces into one pile
to hear and heed, listening to another
being strong and in force, prevailing
a way leading onward, a path
humours and disposition born of them

words.root_logic: re-（再）+ concili（使和好）→ 使重新和好 → 和解；调和
words.origin: 拉丁语 reconciliare：re-（再）+ conciliare（使和好）
words.native_definition: to make two things or people compatible again
words.core_concept: bringing the estranged back together – 把闹翻的重新拢到一处
words.core_image: 兄弟为遗产争了多年，最终坐下来把旧账一笔笔说清，重归于好
examples: It is hard to reconcile the two accounts.
words.recall_hint: re-（再）+ concili（和好）→ 重新和好

words.root_logic: com-（共同）+ par（对等）+ -able → 能放到同一天平上比 → 可比较的
words.origin: 拉丁语 comparabilis：com-（共同）+ par（对等）
words.native_definition: similar enough to be compared with something
words.core_concept: able to be set on the same scale – 能放上同一杆秤
words.core_image: 两款手机摆在展台并列，屏幕、价格、厚度都能放一起权衡
examples: His salary is comparable to mine.
semantic_expansions: 可比较：放得上同一杆秤
words.recall_hint: com-（共同）+ par（对等）→ 能同秤比较

words.root_logic: par（对等）→ 两个对等的东西 → 一对
words.origin: 古法语 paire ← 拉丁语 paria（对等物）← par（相等）
words.native_definition: two things of the same kind used together
words.core_concept: two matched, equal things – 两个对等相配的东西
words.core_image: 抽屉里两只袜子花色相同，摆在一处正好齐整，少了一只就不成样子
examples: He bought a pair of shoes.
The students paired up to practice.
words.recall_hint: par（对等）→ 两个对等 → 一对

words.root_logic: re-（再）+ pair（对等/使就绪）→ 重新使恢复到某种状态 → 修理
words.origin: 古法语 reparer ← 拉丁语 reparare：re-（再）+ parare（使就绪）；parare 与 par 同 PIE *per-
words.native_definition: to fix something broken or damaged
words.core_concept: making it ready again as before – 把它重新弄回原样
words.core_image: 自行车链条掉了，蹲下来一节节挂回齿轮，车又能骑了
words.recall_hint: re-（再）+ pair（使就绪）→ 弄回原样

words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ pile（堆）→ 把散件堆到一起 → 汇编
words.origin: 拉丁语 compilare：com-（一起）+ pilare（堆垛）
words.native_definition: to collect information together to make a report or book
words.core_concept: heaping scattered pieces into one pile – 把零散的都拢成堆
words.core_image: 把历年数据一行行摘下来，排成整齐的表格编成册
examples: They compiled a list of sources.
words.recall_hint: com-（一起）+ pile（堆）→ 堆到一起 → 汇编

words.root_logic: ob-（朝向）+ edi（听）→ 朝着喊话的方向听 → 服从
words.origin: 拉丁语 oboedientia：ob-（朝向）+ audire（听）——'听着办'
words.native_definition: willingness to follow orders or rules
words.core_concept: hearing the direction and acting on it – 听清了照着办
words.core_image: 老师一声令下，全班齐刷刷坐好，动作整齐一致
examples: The dog was trained to obedience.
Obedience to the law is expected.
words.recall_hint: ob-（朝向）+ edi（听）→ 听着办 → 服从

words.root_logic: ob-（朝向）+ edi（听）+ -ent → 愿意听着办的 → 顺从的
words.native_definition: willing to do what one is told
words.core_concept: one who hears and follows – 听着就办的
words.core_image: 训练有素的马儿听到缰绳的轻响就转向，不闹脾气
examples: The obedient dog stayed by his side.
words.recall_hint: ob-（朝向）+ edi（听）+ -ent → 听着就办

words.root_logic: pre-（更）+ val（强）→ 比别处都强、都普及 → 流行的
words.native_definition: existing commonly or widely at a given time
words.core_concept: being the strongest presence around – 在四周占优势地存在
words.core_image: 这座城到处都立着同一家奶茶店的招牌，走两步就撞见一家
examples: The habit is prevalent in rural areas.
semantic_expansions: 流行：占优势地到处存在
words.recall_hint: pre-（更）+ val（强）→ 到处都强 → 流行

words.root_logic: pre-（在前）+ vi（路）→ 在路前面、先走到的 → 先前的
words.origin: 拉丁语 praevius：prae-（在前）+ via（路）
words.native_definition: existing or happening before this one
words.core_concept: the one that walked ahead on the road – 在路上先走到的那个
words.core_image: 翻回上一所学校的学生证，照片里是更年轻的脸
examples: I met him on a previous visit.
words.recall_hint: pre-（在前）+ vi（路）→ 先走上路的

words.root_logic: hum（拟声）→ 低沉持续的嗡嗡声
words.origin: 英语拟声词，模仿嗡嗡声；与拉丁 hum（湿）无关
words.native_definition: to make a low continuous sound; a low continuous sound
words.core_concept: the low steady buzz that fills a quiet room – 充满屋子的低鸣
words.core_image: 夏天傍晚风扇低低震着耳朵，关掉反而觉得少了什么
semantic_expansions: 嗡嗡响：低沉持续的鸣声
哼歌：闭着唇哼出的调子

words.root_logic: humor（体液）→ 古人认为体液决定性情 → 幽默
words.native_definition: the quality of being funny; mood
words.core_concept: the disposition born of one's humours – 由体液定下的那份性情
words.core_image: 台上那人几句话说下来，全场笑声此起彼伏，气氛一下就活了
examples: She was in good humor today.
words.recall_hint: humor（体液）→ 定性情的湿度 → 幽默

words.root_logic: humor（幽默）+ -ous → 有幽默感的 → 幽默的
words.core_concept: carrying a humour that makes people smile – 带趣味、逗人笑
words.core_image: 饭桌上他讲的那个段子，大家都笑了，连不苟言笑的老爸都弯了嘴角
examples: The book is humorous and warm.

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ cess（走）→ 一起往后让 → 让步
words.origin: 拉丁语 concessio：con-（一起）+ cedere（退让）
words.core_concept: yielding ground together – 一起往后退让的那份
words.core_image: 谈判桌上，一方把价格往下调了一档，另一方也松了口
examples: He made a concession on price.
The store runs a food concession.
words.recall_hint: con-（一起）+ cess（走）→ 一起退让

words.root_logic: con-（完全）+ cis（切）→ 把废话切掉 → 简明的
words.origin: 拉丁语 concisus：con-（完全）+ caedere（切）——'切短的'
words.native_definition: short and clear, with no extra words
words.core_concept: cut down to essentials – 切掉多余、只剩要点
words.core_image: 会议纪要只留三行，废话全删，一眼看完
examples: The summary was concise and clear.
semantic_expansions: 简明：切掉废话只剩要点
words.recall_hint: con-（完全）+ cis（切）→ 切短的

words.root_logic: com-（完全）+ ply（填满）→ 满足全部要求 → 遵从
words.origin: 拉丁语 complere：com-（完全）+ plere（填满）
words.native_definition: to obey a rule or law
words.core_concept: filling the requirement completely – 把它填到满足
words.core_image: 接到整改通知后，把每一条要求都做到位，检查组来查样样达标
examples: All staff must comply with the rules.
words.recall_hint: com-（完全）+ ply（填满）→ 填满要求

words.root_logic: suit（跟随）→ 跟着身体的形状走 → 合身、适合
words.origin: 古法语 suite/suivre ← 拉丁语 sequi（跟随）
words.native_definition: to be right for someone; a set of clothes
words.core_concept: following a shape or situation exactly – 贴身跟随、正好合适
words.core_image: 那件西装上身，肩线正落肩头，裤长恰好及鞋面，哪哪都服帖

words.native_definition: right for a particular purpose or person
words.core_concept: able to follow the need exactly – 正好匹配那份需要
words.core_image: 下雨天换上这双防滑鞋，走哪一段路都不打滑
examples: This is a suitable place for the camp.
Find a suitable time to call.

words.root_logic: suite（跟随的一系列）→ 一串相随的东西
words.origin: 法语 suite（随行）← seguir ← sequi（跟随）
words.native_definition: a set of connected rooms; a set of musical pieces
words.core_concept: a series following one after another – 一串连续相随的
words.core_image: 酒店里连着的一套客房，客厅卧室洗手间一溜排开
semantic_expansions: 套房：一连串相通的房间
words.recall_hint: suite（跟随的一系列）→ 相连成套

words.root_logic: pre-（在前）+ vent（来）→ 先一步来到 → 阻止
words.origin: 拉丁语 praevenire：prae-（在前）+ venire（来）
words.core_concept: coming before it so it can't happen – 抢在它前面赶到
words.core_image: 看到前方封路，一脚刹车停住，车没冲进施工区
words.recall_hint: pre-（在前）+ vent（来）→ 先一步到 → 阻止
